name.description: Name of the internal governance body.
name.title: Name

rationale_for_inclusion.description: Brief justification explaining *why* this specific type of internal governance body (e.g., Steering Committee, PMO, Ethics Committee) is necessary or appropriate for *this particular project*, based on its description, scale, or key challenges.
rationale_for_inclusion.title: Rationale For Inclusion

responsibilities.description: Key tasks or responsibilities of this internal body.
responsibilities.title: Responsibilities

initial_setup_actions.description: Key initial actions this body needs to take upon formation (e.g., 'Finalize Terms of Reference', 'Elect Chair', 'Set meeting schedule').
initial_setup_actions.title: Initial Setup Actions

membership.description: Roles or titles of individuals *within the project/organization* forming this internal body.
membership.title: Membership

decision_rights.description: Type and scope of decisions this internal body is empowered to make.
decision_rights.title: Decision Rights

decision_mechanism.description: How decisions are typically made within this internal body. Specify tie-breaker if applicable.
decision_mechanism.title: Decision Mechanism

meeting_cadence.description: How often this internal body meets.
meeting_cadence.title: Meeting Cadence

typical_agenda_items.description: Example recurring items for this internal body's meetings.
typical_agenda_items.title: Typical Agenda Items

escalation_path.description: Where or to which *other internal body or senior project/organization role* issues exceeding authority are escalated.
escalation_path.title: Escalation Path

internal_governance_bodies.description: List of all internal governance bodies with roles, responsibilities, and membership.
internal_governance_bodies.title: Internal Governance Bodies
